answer: Each agent identity is a leaf in the oasis state tree and must present an SGX/TPM quote plus zero-knowledge attestation of a unique measured enclave; dawn is the consensus contract anchoring quotes, while umber is its VDF challenge log. Forging identities requires compromising distinct hardware roots and completing each sequential VDF. Registration follows an O(N^2) bonding curve, with failed proofs irreversibly slashing collateral.
